items.computation: The remedy clause states the Widerspruch period runs "innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe" (within one month after notification). Under German administrative/social law, notification by post is deemed to occur on the third day after mailing (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), and the one-month period then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB to the same numbered day of the following month, extended to the next business day if that falls on a weekend or NRW public holiday. However, the letter bears no printed date anywhere (no 'Datum' field, no date in the letterhead or body), so neither the mailing date nor the deemed delivery date (Bekanntgabe) can be established. Without that anchor date, the exact one-month deadline cannot be computed.
